feedback: The illustration beautifully captures Jesus in a Galilean village standing between the eager, seated crowd on the left and the stern, crossed-armed men on the right, perfectly matching the narrative context.

The illustration beautifully depicts Jesus narrating the parable with the tearful, ragged son sitting among pigs in a drought-stricken landscape holding carob pods.
The illustration beautifully captures Jesus warmly teaching with open arms while the background perfectly depicts the loving father embracing his returning ragged son alongside festive musicians.
The illustration beautifully captures Jesus narrating in the foreground while the older brother stands outside the warmly lit, celebrating house, listening to the servant.
The illustration accurately portrays Jesus speaking in the foreground while the father and older son converse outside the entrance in the background.

Jesus is depicted teaching with an open, thoughtful posture while the older son stands isolated near the glowing doorway with a rigid stance, effectively illustrating the passage's theme of emotional and spiritual detachment.
The illustration beautifully captures Jesus gesturing with tender warmth while the father in the background lovingly comforts his troubled son under the evening sky.
The illustration beautifully captures Jesus standing before a contemplative crowd in an outdoor village setting, conveying the solemn silence and deep reflection described in the story.
The illustration beautifully captures Jesus with an open, welcoming embrace toward a diverse crowd in warm golden light, perfectly matching the theme of God's universal invitation of grace.
